concerns.text: Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires datasets to be checksummed and stored under `data/`. The plan states 'Storage: N/A (data generated in memory and processed)' and 'Data will be generated programmatically. No external data sources are used.' This contradicts the requirement to persist and checksum data for reproducibility (Principle I) and hygiene (Principle III). The plan must explicitly state how generated data (SquarefreeSequence, GapDataset) is persisted to disk with checksums.

Constitution Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) requires all figures/statistics to trace back to `data/` and `code/`. The plan's 'Storage: N/A' and 'processed in memory' stance prevents the creation of a persistent SSoT data layer. The plan must define a data persistence strategy (e.g., saving .npy or .csv files to `data/`) to satisfy Principle IV.

Constitution Principle VI (Deterministic Sieving) is listed, but the plan does not explicitly mention the implementation of a deterministic linear sieve in the 'Technical Context' or 'Project Structure' sections. While implied by the file `squarefree.py`, the plan should explicitly state that the sieve implementation adheres to Principle VI to ensure cross-doc consistency.

Constitution Principle VII (Rigorous Statistical Convergence) requires reporting KS statistics as a function of log N. The plan mentions 'Statistical claims will be supported by KS test p-values' but does not explicitly mention the 'convergence analysis plot' or the specific requirement to vary N across scales ($10^6, 5	imes10^6, 10^7$) in the 'Technical Context' or 'Project Structure' sections, unlike the spec and research docs.

The 'Project Structure' lists `src/main.py` but does not explicitly reference the generation of the control dataset (random thinning) required by FR-006 and the Spec. The plan should mention a module or function for the control dataset generation to ensure all spec requirements are exercised by the plan.
